script: This is what happens when LaMelo and Lonzo play each other! You see, Melo claims no one can really guard him in the league, as his playstyle is very unique with how he moves with the ball. But against his big brother, he can't do anything. Every time LaMelo was guarded by Lonzo, he couldn't even get a shot up, forcing LaMelo to pass to his teammates. And Lonzo was able to play all this perfect defense because he knows all of his little brother's moves.
what_makes_it_work: Compelling matchup between two famous brothers in the NBA
Dynamic cuts highlighting defensive lockdown sequences
